Here, `bottomLeft` provides the x and y components, and `voxelPosViewSpace.zw` provides the z and w components. Since the w component is set to `voxelPosViewSpace.w` (which is typically 1.0 for position vectors in view space), the vector passed to the projection matrix is effectively `[x, y, z, 1.0]`. Thus, the evidence supports the claim.
